name: waveform
title: Waveform Bars
description: Equalizer bars in a blue to pink gradient pulse across the middle of the frame, like an audio visualizer.
useWhen: A music, podcast or voice moment needs an audio-visualizer look with no audio analysis.
A tech backdrop of pulsing bars in two brand colors.
avoidWhen: The bars must follow a real audio track: this one is generated from time, not from sound.
You need a single flowing line: use sine-wave.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Left color
variables.description: Color of the bars at the left edge.

variables.label: Right color
variables.description: Color of the bars at the right edge.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Bars
variables.description: How many bars span the frame.

variables.label: Max height
variables.description: Tallest a bar gets, as a share of the shorter side of the frame.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it if edges look soft.
